text:
harper: heads up — GreenLeaf (acct GL-78321) just got suspended by dunning. customer says they already sent a PO and refuses that the charge is overdue. invoice INV-2026-0456 for $12,450. attached PDF claim. <file attached: PO_GL78321.pdf>
rebecca: thanks. sending to finance for quick look. do we have the PO number in the billing system?
omar: checking now. stripe/charge id `ch_3KxYz...` shows 3 failed attempts: 2026-03-10, 2026-03-12, 2026-03-14. last decline reason: `card_declined` (issuer). no PO recorded on the account in our AR system.
harper: customer (marta from GreenLeaf) says PO# GL-78321 matches their internal. they forwarded a signed PO to support@redwood.com on 2026-03-11. support ticket 84712.
marta-cs: @harper fyi i confirmed support thread — they uploaded the PO but CS didn't attach to billing because they were told to wait for finance review. ticket notes: "PO attached, please don't suspend".
omar: ok. i pulled the PDF — PO looks valid but it lacks the exact invoice reference (INV-2026-0456). PO shows total $12,450 and billing address in EU (DE). there's a VAT field blank. possible tax mismatch flagged by our tax validator.
rebecca: VAT missing could block PO matching. but we usually accept PO + post-invoice if customer signs. what does the dunning policy say for a signed PO? can we hold suspension pending PO validation?
omar: policy: if a valid signed PO is provided and account disputes dunning within 7 days, we can pause suspension for 72h while AR validates. but finance needs the PO in our GL system and VAT cleared.
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-0456 entered dunning stage 3. Next action: service suspension scheduled in 24h unless payment/PO provided.
harper: customer emailed escalation to their procurement. they want an immediate restore while procurement completes PO matching. can we grant temporary access? they stressed it's production impacting.
rebecca: propose: 72h temporary reinstate with last-30-day usage limit, require PO number and signed copy in AR email chain. if card successful in meantime, reconcile and close.
omar: i can approve provisional restore if CS attaches PO to the billing ticket and finance gets explicit written confirmation from customer contact (name + title). also need VAT status — ask them to confirm VAT ID or that they're tax-exempt.
marta-cs: will ping the customer now and request VAT id + confirm they'd re-send PO including invoice number. pinging @marta-customer: "Can you confirm VAT ID and resend PO with invoice number? We can provisionally restore once we have the signed PO attached to the billing ticket." :email:
harper: adding note — account has some alarms triggered in usage. limit to 10 concurrent reqs while provisional.
omar: if they can't supply VAT id, we need a workaround: either full prepayment or escalation to legal for contract amendment (slow). finance prefers PO + VAT or prepay.
rebecca: please hold on suspension for 72h. omar — can you mark account with `hold_from_suspension: true` and notify AR team? reply with confirmation when done.
omar: done. tagged AR and set hold flag in billing console. ticket link: https://redwood.internal/billing/tickets/84712
billing-bot: [automated] Account GL-78321 hold flag applied by omar at 2026-03-15T15:08Z
marta-cs: customer replied: they can provide VAT ID (DE123456789) and will re-issue PO with invoice ref within 24h. they asked for confirm restore immediately.
harper: thanks. i restored read-only access and limited runtime to safe mode. customer confirmed their devs can test but not full traffic. :thumbsup:
rebecca: once PO lands, i'll process match and send AR confirmation. if charge goes through before match, we'll reconcile and cancel dunning.
omar: make sure CS attaches the new PO to ticket 84712 and cc billing@redwood.com. i'll run VAT validation on DE123456789 when we have official doc.
harper: any blockers left? if not i'll close loop with customer and monitor.
rebecca: none. omar, please escalate to collections if PO not received by 72h.
omar: noted. will escalate EOD + create collections task if no PO.
harper: closing for now — follow ups in ticket 84712. :white_check_mark:
